dedupe_keys.name: esa irrigation regional irrigation water estimates from space ebro po murray darling

description: These are the first regional high-resolution irrigation water datasets obtained from satellite observations, produced in the European Space Agency Irrigation+ project and described in an Earth System Science Data paper. Irrigation amounts are estimated with a soil-moisture-based inversion approach; the European products use Sentinel-1 soil moisture from a first-order radiative transfer model. Coverage is three basins: the Ebro basin in northeastern Spain and the Po valley in northern Italy at 1 km, and the Murray-Darling basin in southeastern Australia at 6 km. The data are a free download from Zenodo under CC BY 4.0. Caveats: the amounts are retrievals validated against benchmark rates over selected districts, not metered deliveries, and the Australian grid is coarser. Simulation uses: irrigation water demand and timing for scheme operation, capacity planning and drought adaptation. Related records: LANID (data-lanid-landsat-irrigation-dataset-us) and GMIE maximum irrigation extent (data-gmie-global-maximum-irrigation-extent).
